title.zh: 写出按时间充电的函数

concept.zh: 按时间用乘法计算电量
concept.en: Multiply the time and the charging rate

brief.zh: 写好 charge_needed(minutes, per_minute)。每分钟都能充入同样多的电量，返回按指定分钟数能充入的总量。
brief.en: Complete charge_needed(minutes, per_minute). Each minute adds the same amount of charge. Return the total added over the given number of minutes.

hints.zh: 如果每分钟充 3 格，充 2 分钟，就是 2 × 3 格。零分钟会得到 0 格。
hints.en: If one minute adds three units, two minutes adds 2 × 3 units. Zero minutes adds zero.

hints.zh: 运行检查两种参数改变时的结果，通过后把函数保存到我的算法。
hints.en: Run the tests with both parameters changing, then save the function to My algorithms.

hints.zh: 把光标点到代码末尾，点击「把时间和充电速度相乘」就能添加返回指令。
hints.en: Click at the end of the code, then click Multiply Time by Rate to insert the return statement.

solutionCode:
def charge_needed(minutes, per_minute):
    return minutes * per_minute

label.zh: 把时间和充电速度相乘
